tables.title_as_printed: Geochemical Laboratory Report / Uranerz Exploration & Mining Ltd. 4/4 Report 80-075C

structured.legibility_notes: This page ("4/4", Report 80-075C) from Uranerz Exploration & Mining Ltd.'s Geochemical Laboratory Report shows a continuation table of sample assay results (U, Cu, Co, Zn, Ni, Pb, Ag in ppm) with no header block for hole ID, coordinates, elevation, dip, azimuth, total depth, or dates - none are printed on this page. Handwritten annotations in the left margin (e.g. "ER", "DF-45", "DF-44", "DF-46", "KL-10", and stray digits "9", "4") appear to group rows by drillhole, connected by hand-drawn brackets; these groupings are ambiguous and I have only attributed a hole_id label to the row where the handwritten text sits directly beside it (marked uncertain=true), leaving other rows in the same bracket as not_printed rather than guessing. A handwritten "44" appears beside sample 38347 and "DF" beside 38346; these are transcribed as separate uncertain annotations. Three unlabeled blank columns follow the Ag ppm column with no data. Stamped text "74 F 08 0021" appears in the lower right corner outside the table grid and is not part of the drillhole data table.
